font-family.$description: Font family for short eyebrow labels with .eyebrow applied directly or as a child of a .prose container.

font-size.$description: Font size for short eyebrow labels with .eyebrow applied directly or as a child of a .prose container.

font-weight.$description: Font weight for short eyebrow labels with .eyebrow applied directly or as a child of a .prose container.

line-height.$description: Line height for short eyebrow labels with .eyebrow applied directly or as a child of a .prose container.

letter-spacing.$description: Tracking for short eyebrow labels with .eyebrow applied directly or as a child of a .prose container.

measure.$description: Maximum inline measure for short eyebrow labels with .eyebrow applied directly or as a child of a .prose container.

spacing-before.$description: Incoming spacing request when an eyebrow follows another direct child in a .prose flow. The resolved gap is the larger of this spacing-before and the previous treatment's spacing-after, so structural hierarchy wins without relying on source order.

spacing-after.$description: Outgoing spacing request contributed by an eyebrow to the next direct child in a .prose flow. The resolved gap normally uses the larger of this spacing-after and the next treatment's spacing-before; eyebrow + heading is an intentional compound exception that keeps this tighter outgoing gap.

color.$description: Text color for short eyebrow labels with .eyebrow applied directly or as a child of a .prose container.

font-style.$description: Font style for short eyebrow labels with .eyebrow applied directly or as a child of a .prose container.

text-transform.$description: Text transform for short eyebrow labels with .eyebrow applied directly or as a child of a .prose container.

text-align.$description: Text alignment for short eyebrow labels with .eyebrow applied directly or as a child of a .prose container.
